data.raw_text:
We had a retreat in the Philippines

rented out an entire private island for the team

- fire dancing 
- beach villas 
- peacocks everywhere 

went up to this spot called the sea of clouds where you're literally above the clouds in the mountains

AND THEN THREE (3) earthquakes hit while we were there

last retreat two and a half years ago we swam through a venomous sea snake mating ground without knowing it. captain got his head smashed trying to dock in sudden high waves

between those retreats? nothing 
zero incidents in Davao City for 30 months straight

i fly my team down and nature decides to test us again

- 6 people died in the city from the quakes
- poorly constructed buildings
- air conditioners falling

we were safe on the island but i'm supposed to be the leader keeping everyone comfortable

instead i'm watching the ground move like we're on a boat

but this is why we do these things

you can't build a real team over Zoom calls and Slack messages

we did team building exercises. 
hired a specialist who made us fish balls out of containers using chopsticks. 
sounds weird but it forced us to figure out communication and strategy under pressure

asked questions. learned how people actually think when problems hit

remote work is efficient but there's something that only happens face to face

my team has a different appreciation for each other now

worth every earthquake
